notes: Tail case, all units re-examined. U1 whole-person recolour re-scoped to the welding helmet (v2; the black shirt could not be segmented cleanly under smoke/arc glare). U2 replace made structural. U3 trolley wheel (part of the cylinder cart; removal physically odd) retargeted to the upright sledgehammer (v2). U4 noun fixed to steel rod, payload wraps around it.

difficulty.evidence_zh: 焊工的焊接面罩、右侧蓝绿色气瓶、竖立的大锤和左侧细钢棒是四个不同对象，焊接弧光和烟雾干扰。
difficulty.specific_protection_zh: 保留工人、工具和车间环境。

spec.ref: the black welding helmet of the welder

units.instruction_ref_zh: 将焊工的黑色焊接面罩的颜色改为亮红色。
units.instruction_noref_zh: 将选中区域的颜色改为亮红色。
units.reason: Mask was the whole welder. SAM3 shirt candidates were fragmented by smoke and arc glare (missing sleeve, spurious smoke blob), so the edit targets the clearly bounded helmet; v2 mask = helmet shell (tinted lens excluded).

spec.ref: the teal gas cylinder with a chain at the right

units.ref_zh: 右侧挂着链条的蓝绿色气瓶
units.instruction_ref_zh: 将右侧挂着链条的蓝绿色气瓶替换为一个红色灭火器。
units.instruction_noref_zh: 将选中区域替换为一个红色灭火器。
units.reason: 'a red cylinder' was only a recolour. Ref disambiguates from the dark red cylinder behind the hoses.

spec.ref: the sledgehammer standing upright left of the welder

units.instruction_ref_zh: 移除焊工左侧竖立的大锤。
units.reason: Retarget: the masked wheel belongs to the gas-cylinder trolley (removing it would leave the cart unsupported) and its ref was vague. The upright sledgehammer is unique and free-standing; v2 mask via SAM3 text 'sledgehammer'.

spec.ref: the thin shiny steel rod lying diagonally at the left
spec.payload: one strip of yellow-and-black hazard tape

units.instruction_ref_zh: 给左侧斜放的细亮钢棒缠上一条黄黑相间的警示胶带。
units.instruction_noref_zh: 给选中区域缠上一条黄黑相间的警示胶带。
units.reason: Mask is a single thin steel rod, not an 'assembly'; a flat label on a thin rod is awkward, tape wrapped around it is natural.
